info.name: Mohammad Kourani - Users, Audit Logging, Notifications
info.description:
Postman collection for the services built by Mohammad Kourani: Users and Identity, Security Audit Logging, and Notifications.

**Before running:** `python init_db.py` (fresh sample data), then `python run.py`.

Run the folders in order (or use Run collection). The Setup folder logs in one test account per role and stores the tokens in collection variables. No real secrets are stored here.
